referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes infrastucture and electricity (electricity mix UCTE) for heat pump. Includes emissions of refrigerant (R134a) during operation. Heat at heat pump, i.e. heat distribution in the house is not included. Infrastructure extrapolated from brine-water heat pump using a correction factor.
referenceFunction.name: Heat, at air-water heat pump 10kW

geography.text: Conditions of operation extrapolated from Switzerland to RER. Operation with UCTE electricity mix.

technology.text: Based on average SPF2 (Seasonal Performance Factor, including auxiliary energy) of air-water heat pumps installed in year 1998 operating in Switzerland.
